Description:
  Agent Hosting agent operations.

Usage:
  msagent agent [subgroup] [command] [options]

Subgroups:
  eval     Run Copilot Studio evaluations against an MCS agent. MCS only.

Commands:
  create   Create an agent project.
  init     Register an MCS project or standalone workflow that already exists on disk. Creates no files and nothing in Copilot Studio.
  list     List the MCS agents or standalone workflows in an environment or across the tenant. One that has never been deployed is not listed.
  show     Show the managed-agent records this project holds. Reads the local configuration and contacts nothing.
  pull     Bring the remote MCS agent's content into the project, taking every component collection beside it.
  delete   Delete an MCS agent's cloud resources and every record for it. Local files are never touched.
  deploy   Deploy an agent to a named deployment.
  share    Share an MCS agent with a user.
  unshare  Remove a user's access to an MCS agent. MCS only.

Options:
  -?, -h  --help             Show help and usage information
  -j      --json             Emit machine-readable JSON output.
  -dbg    --debug            Display debugging information, such as redacted API responses, on stderr.
  -nc     --no-color         Disable colored output.
  -ni     --non-interactive  Do not open a browser or broker sign-in, fail instead.

Description:
  Create an agent project.

Usage:
  Scaffold a new MCS agent
    msagent agent create --agent-type MCSAgent --agent-name <agent-name> --description <description> --initial-prompt <initial-prompt> [options]
  Clone an existing MCS agent
    msagent agent create [--agent-type MCSAgent] (--mcs-clone-agent-id <id> | --mcs-clone-agent-schemaname <schema-name>) [options]

Options:
  -an, -n  --agent-name, --name          Agent or workflow display name. Optional when cloning, which inherits the source name.
  -d       --description                 Agent description. Required for a new MCS agent.
  -eid     --environment-id              Target environment id. Defaults to the active environment.
  -p       --project                     Project directory to initialize. Defaults to the current directory, created if missing.
  -at      --agent-type                  Agent type. Use MCSAgent for an MCS project, or MCSWorkflow for a standalone cloud flow.
  -sn      --schema-name                 MCS schema name. Derived from --agent-name when omitted. MCS only.
  -mat     --mcs-agent-type              Scaffold shape: CLI (default) or Classic. MCS only.
  -it      --init-template               Scaffold template name. Requires --mcs-agent-type Classic. MCS only.
  -ip      --initial-prompt              Instructions scaffolded into the project. Required for a new MCS agent. MCS only.
  -mcas    --mcs-clone-agent-schemaname  Clone this schema name instead of scaffolding. MCS only.
  -mcaid   --mcs-clone-agent-id          Clone this agent id instead of scaffolding. MCS only.
  -mcwid   --mcs-clone-workflow-id       Clone this workflow id instead of scaffolding. MCSWorkflow only.
  -mceid   --mcs-clone-environment-id    Clone source environment. Defaults to --environment-id, then the active one. MCS only.
  -?, -h   --help                        Show help and usage information
  -j       --json                        Emit machine-readable JSON output.
  -dbg     --debug                       Display debugging informatio
